description: §7.6 rule (c) (S479): a tool has no requests and no other users — a file-scope `let` written by `main` and by a helper is not E-FILE-SCOPE-LET-SERVER-WRITE.
rationale: §7.6 rule (c) (S479): "A `kind=\"tool\"` program (§64) has no client boundary (§64.5.1), no requests and no other users: a file-scope `let` its functions write is the one process's own state … so rule (c) does not apply to it." ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — #1962 file-scope questions 1–4 + `parseVariant` duplicate keys, PA recs adopted" item 1.
